description: Plan a customer-owned production hostname before or after the first Prod deployment. This reads the project and describes declaration and activation without changing DNS. domain_paid_apply can declare a hostname as awaiting_deployment for early Cloudflare consent. Without Paid, only a project that shows the powered-by flag (powered_by_flag_get) can connect its own hostname; for any other Free project domain_paid_apply answers paid_plan_required.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: domain_paid_plan
